decision.rationale: Fresh exact-SHA replay is byte-identical and independent event endpoints reproduce 543,784,143 baseline cycles versus 563,718,054 full-row candidate cycles, or 0.9646385x. The 60,736,222-cycle zero-dispatch term is exactly twice 30,368,111 raw zero rows. Removing it arithmetically exposes a plausible active-only successor, but changes descriptor count, address progression, replay startup and queue timestamps, so subtraction alone is not a finite-event result.

findings.title: FIFO occupancy and producer stalls are bounded analytically rather than timestamped
findings.detail: M373 assigns maximum_bundle_fifo_occupancy_upper=min(depth,8) without advancing enqueue/dequeue state. The post-start no-underflow claim is valid because zero bundles take one cycle and every active O4 bundle takes at least four while production is at most one per cycle, but occupancy, full backpressure and drain are not explicit events.

findings.title: Descriptor read/FIFO startup latency is unspecified and uncharged
findings.detail: M373 starts compute at descriptor replay start with no first-bundle latency. Conservatively adding one cycle to each of 34,560 tile replays changes candidate cycles to 563,752,614 and speedup to 0.9645794x, preserving NO-GO. A fall-through or prefetched implementation could avoid this, but it must be stated and verified.

findings.title: Descriptor traffic is phase-coarse rather than row-event complete
findings.detail: Each phase has one 18,000-byte write event and two 18,000-byte replay events, not 3,000 timestamped writes and reads. Matcher duration is always at least 3,044 cycles, so one write per retirement is feasible, but row-level arbitration and backpressure remain unobserved.

findings.title: The 32-byte alignment statement needs address-space scope
findings.detail: Every DMA address and payload length is 32-byte aligned and slots do not overflow. Descriptor bank1 begins at byte 83,536, which is 16 mod 32; this is valid for the modeled private 48-bit-row SRAM because it is not DMA payload, but a unified burst-addressed map should round and regenerate addresses.

findings.title: The active-only speedup is an arithmetic preview, not finite-event evidence
findings.detail: 563,718,054 minus 60,736,222 gives 502,981,832 and 1.0811208x; adding one startup per tile gives 503,016,392 and 1.0810466x. Neither number is admitted by M378 because compact addresses, exact active conservation, empty partitions, timestamped queue behavior and an RTL controller have not been verified here.
